Note key risk: Horner in fp32 with catastrophic cancellation — coefficients[:,0] crafted so polynomial at anchor ≈ 0.003, but the partial sums are huge (~sum of powers ~ anchor^48/(anchor-1) large?). Actually sum of coefficients*anchor^k ≈ 0.003 while intermediate Horner values grow to large magnitude ~ sum of |terms| ≈ sum of powers which is huge (anchor^48 ≈ 2.1). Reference is tiny (~0.003), so relative error can be large. That's the core risk.
